thread:
morgan: heads up - seeing a spike in SAML signature validation failures in prod auth-audit starting ~10:12 UTC. multiple customers impacted, error="InvalidSignature". possible idp key mismatch.
ellie: can you paste logs? any idp cert rotations today? :eyes:
morgan: logs show repeated:
`2026-03-21T10:12:05Z ERROR saml: assertion validation failed user=alice@example.com err=InvalidSignature key_kid=Yk7f request_id=abc123`
satya: did we deploy anything to saml verifier or KMS? deploy-bot shows config push at 09:58 by riley, no runtime code deploys.
riley: I rolled a metadata backfill at 09:55 that only reads idp metadata and caches jwks. not expected to change keys. I can revert.
kms-bot: automated: no customer KMS rekey events in last 24h; last rotate 2026-02-10.
sec-oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-187 created, paging sec oncall.
morgan: key_kid Yk7f is present in incoming assertions but NOT in our cached JWKs.
riley: doing live metadata fetch from idp now.
riley: metadata shows two signing keys: Rv3a (old) and Yk7f (new). our cache only had Rv3a — backfill failed earlier.
ellie: cache freshness?
morgan: metadata_last_fetch=2026-03-21T02:14:03Z, backfill log shows 504 at ~02:10 and no retry.
satya: impact: new assertions signed by Yk7f rejected. mitigation: add Yk7f to cache ASAP. do NOT fail-open.
riley: one-off job to reload JWKs pushed, cache updated. monitoring: errors dropping.
morgan: confirmed affected users can authenticate again.
ellie: root cause: transient metadata fetch failure + no retry left cache stale across idp key rotation. follow-ups: add retry/backoff, alert on high InvalidSignature rate, surface cache freshness in console, update runbook for idp rekeys.
satya: verify SCIM paths not using signed callbacks; add note for customers that rotate keys frequently.
morgan: no signs of tampering; logs point to legitimate idp rotate. I'll collect affected org IDs for postmortem.
riley: opening follow-up ticket with org IDs and cache metric request.
ellie: assigning incident owner, drafting postmortem. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
